channel.title: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the FDA recalls press-release feed
channel.description: Fictional items for tests and demos

item.title: Bahar Imports Recalls Anatolia Pantry Red Lentils Because of Possible Foreign Material
item.description: Bahar Imports Corp. is recalling 1 kg and 2 kg bags of Anatolia Pantry red lentils that may contain small stones.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Example Farms Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Sesame in Bread Rolls
item.description: Example Farms is recalling bread rolls because they contain sesame that is not on the label.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Sample Pharmacy Recalls Compounded Eye Drops Due to Lack of Sterility Assurance
item.description: Sample Pharmacy is recalling eye drops because sterility cannot be assured.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Classic Car Wax Spray Recalled for Flammability Labeling
item.description: A car-care spray sold as Classic is recalled over missing flammability warnings.
item.dc:creator: FDA
